recipes.title: Cheesy Scrambled Egg Breakfast Quesadilla

ingredients.name: shredded cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese

steps: Whisk eggs with salt and black pepper in a small bowl until fully combined.
Melt half the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Pour in beaten eggs and scramble gently with a spatula for 2 to 3 minutes until soft curds form; remove to a plate.
Wipe skillet, melt remaining butter over medium heat, and place one tortilla in the pan.
Layer half the shredded cheese, the warm scrambled eggs, chopped chives, and remaining cheese across the tortilla.
Top with second tortilla and cook 2 to 3 minutes until golden brown; carefully flip and toast other side for 2 minutes until cheese melts completely.
Slide onto a cutting board, slice into wedges, and serve with salsa.
recipes.swaps: Corn tortillas can replace flour tortillas; pepper jack or feta can replace cheddar.

recipes.title: Healthy Baked Cheddar and Parmesan Breakfast Casserole

source.name: Our 50 Most-Popular Healthy Recipes - Food Network

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease an 8x8-inch baking dish.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Sauté diced onion and broccoli for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp-tender.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper together until smooth.
Spread sautéed vegetables across the bottom of the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar and grated Parmesan over the vegetables, then pour the egg mixture evenly over the top.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until the center is set and top is lightly puffed and golden (reaching 160°F internal temp).
Cool 5 minutes before slicing into squares.
recipes.swaps: Bell peppers or mushrooms can replace broccoli; Swiss or Gruyère can replace cheddar.

recipes.title: Gentle-Heat Soft Scrambled Eggs with Chives

source.name: 10 Mistakes Everyone Makes Cooking Eggs - Food Network

steps: Crack eggs on a flat counter and place in a bowl. Whisk vigorously with a fork until yolks and whites are completely uniform.
Melt butter in a small nonstick skillet over medium-low heat until foaming but not browned.
Pour in beaten eggs. Let sit undisturbed for 20 seconds until a thin layer sets on the bottom.
Using a silicone spatula, slowly push eggs from the edges toward the center, forming soft folds.
Continue gently folding over low heat for 2 to 3 minutes until soft curds form; remove pan from heat while eggs still look slightly moist.
Season with salt, black pepper, and snipped fresh chives. Serve immediately onto warm plates.
recipes.swaps: Ghee or olive oil can replace butter; parsley can replace chives.

recipes.title: Crispy-Edge Sunny-Side-Up Fried Eggs

source.name: 10 Mistakes Everyone Makes Cooking Eggs - Food Network

steps: Heat oil or butter in a skillet over medium-high heat until hot and shimmering.
Crack eggs onto a flat surface, then carefully slip both eggs into the hot skillet.
Immediately turn the burner heat down to low to prevent the center from overcooking.
Tilt the pan slightly and spoon hot oil over the whites near the yolk to help them set.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes until egg whites are opaque and edges are golden-crisp, with yolk remaining warm and liquid.
Slide onto a plate, season with salt and pepper, and serve immediately.

source_temperatures.target: Medium-high heat, immediately reduced to low

recipes.swaps: Can be flipped for 30 seconds for over-easy eggs; bacon grease can replace olive oil.
